findings.issue: No message pagination in chat-view — fetches all messages at once with no cursor/offset limit
findings.impact: Long channels have unbounded load times and memory consumption
findings.fix: Implement cursor-based pagination: load initial 50 messages, fetch older on scroll-to-top

findings.issue: Typing indicator events not throttled on the server side — only client-side throttle at 2000ms
findings.impact: Rapid typing changes still fire many events; no server-side protection against flooding
findings.fix: Add rate limiting on socket typing:start events server-side; keep client throttle as defense-in-depth

findings.issue: Optimistic messages lack visual distinction (e.g., grayed out) for 'sending' state
findings.impact: Users cannot distinguish between pending (optimistic) and confirmed messages — confusion if message fails
findings.fix: Apply reduced opacity or spinner indicator to optimistic messages; revert on failure with toast error

findings.issue: Thread reply input uses fixed rows={2} — does not auto-resize unlike the main message input
findings.impact: Long thread replies require manual scrolling in the textarea; inconsistent with main message input UX
findings.fix: Replace fixed rows with auto-resize behavior matching message-input.tsx

findings.issue: No icon library — all icons are Unicode/emoji characters throughout the app
findings.impact: Inconsistent cross-platform rendering; no accessibility attributes on emoji icons; no SVG theming
findings.fix: Adopt an icon library (lucide-react recommended) with consistent aria-label and aria-hidden patterns

findings.issue: No typography scale or design tokens for heading/text variants — uses raw Tailwind classes
findings.impact: Inconsistent text sizing across pages; no design system guardrails for typography
findings.fix: Define typography scale tokens in globals.css; create Text and Heading components

findings.issue: Raw opacity values used directly (opacity-50, opacity-70, etc.) — no design tokens
Notification dropdown lacks max-height — long notification lists extend beyond viewport
findings.impact: Users with many notifications cannot scroll within the dropdown; notifications overflow below viewport
findings.fix: Add max-h-96 overflow-y-auto to notification dropdown container

findings.issue: Reply-to bar shows only 'Replying to [name]' without preview of the replied-to message content
findings.impact: Users must remember or scroll to find the original message they're replying to
findings.fix: Add truncated preview of the replied-to message content below the name in the reply bar

findings.issue: Search results don't highlight the matched query terms in the excerpt
findings.impact: Users cannot quickly see why a result matched their search query
findings.fix: Highlight matching query terms in search result snippets using <mark> or bold

findings.issue: Message actions (reply, react, edit, delete) are hidden until hover — opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100
findings.impact: On touch devices or with mouse-free navigation, message actions are not visible
findings.fix: Show message actions always on mobile/touch; keep hover-with-focus pattern for desktop

findings.issue: No shared ButtonGroup component — login form mode toggle (Sign In/Sign Up) uses manually styled buttons
findings.impact: Inconsistent button group styling; no reusable pattern for segmented controls
findings.fix: Create shared ButtonGroup component with active state styling
